```{python}
import urllib.request
import os
import io
import csv

# ── output folder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("data", exist_ok=True)
```
```{python}
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1.  GLOBAL TEMPERATURE ANOMALY  (NASA GISTEMP v4)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════

print("Fetching NASA GISTEMP v4 temperature data...")

TEMP_URL = "https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/tabledata_v4/GLB.Ts+dSST.csv"

urllib.request.urlretrieve(TEMP_URL, "data/raw_gistemp.csv")

# Parse: skip the first row (header note), keep Year + J-D (annual mean) column
rows = []
with open("data/raw_gistemp.csv", newline="") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    next(reader)                        # skip blank/title line
    headers = next(reader)             # Year, Jan, Feb, ... J-D, D-N, ...
    jd_col = headers.index("J-D")      # annual mean column

    for row in reader:
        year = row[0].strip()
        if not year.isdigit():
            continue
        anomaly = row[jd_col].strip()
        if anomaly in ("", "****"):     # missing values
            anomaly = ""
        rows.append({"year": int(year), "temp_anomaly_C": anomaly})

# Filter to 1990–2024 and save
with open("data/temperature_anomaly.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["year", "temp_anomaly_C"])
    writer.writeheader()
    for r in rows:
        if 1990 <= r["year"] <= 2024:
            writer.writerow(r)

print(f"  ✓ Saved data/temperature_anomaly.csv  ({sum(1990<=r['year']<=2024 for r in rows)} rows)")

```

```{python}
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.  US TORNADO COUNTS  (NOAA Storm Prediction Center)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
print("Fetching NOAA SPC tornado data...")

TORNADO_URL = "https://www.spc.noaa.gov/wcm/data/1950-2022_actual_tornadoes.csv"

urllib.request.urlretrieve(TORNADO_URL, "data/raw_tornadoes.csv")

# Aggregate: count tornadoes per year, also count strong ones (mag >= 2)
from collections import defaultdict
tornado_counts   = defaultdict(int)
strong_counts    = defaultdict(int)   # EF/F2 and above

with open("data/raw_tornadoes.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        try:
            year = int(row["yr"])
            mag  = int(row["mag"]) if row["mag"].strip() not in ("", "-9") else -1
        except ValueError:
            continue
        tornado_counts[year] += 1
        if mag >= 2:
            strong_counts[year] += 1

with open("data/tornado_counts.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(["year", "total_tornadoes", "strong_tornadoes_EF2plus"])
    for year in sorted(tornado_counts):
        if 1990 <= year <= 2022:
            writer.writerow([year, tornado_counts[year], strong_counts[year]])

print(f"  ✓ Saved data/tornado_counts.csv  (1990–2022)")
```

```{python}

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3.  GLOBAL TROPICAL CYCLONES  (NOAA IBTrACS — all basins)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("Fetching NOAA IBTrACS tropical cyclone data (this file is ~100 MB, may take a minute)...")

IBTRACS_URL = (
    "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/international-best-track-archive-for-climate-stewardship-ibtracs"
    "/v04r01/access/csv/ibtracs.since1980.list.v04r01.csv"
)

urllib.request.urlretrieve(IBTRACS_URL, "data/raw_ibtracs.csv")

# Aggregate per year: count unique storms, count Category 3+ (wind >= 96 kt)
storm_years   = defaultdict(set)
intense_years = defaultdict(set)

with open("data/raw_ibtracs.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f, skipinitialspace=True)
    next(reader)   # IBTrACS has a second header row with units — skip it

    for row in reader:
        sid  = row.get("SID", "").strip()
        season = row.get("SEASON", "").strip()
        wind_str = row.get("USA_WIND", "").strip()   # knots, best-track wind

        if not season.isdigit() or not sid:
            continue
        year = int(season)
        if not (1990 <= year <= 2024):
            continue

        storm_years[year].add(sid)

        try:
            wind = float(wind_str)
            if wind >= 96:                            # Category 3+ threshold
                intense_years[year].add(sid)
        except ValueError:
            pass

with open("data/cyclone_counts.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(["year", "total_named_storms", "category3plus_storms"])
    for year in sorted(storm_years):
        writer.writerow([year, len(storm_years[year]), len(intense_years[year])])

print(f"  ✓ Saved data/cyclone_counts.csv  (1990–2024, all global basins)")

print("\n✅ All done!  Files saved to ./data/")
print("   data/temperature_anomaly.csv")
print("   data/tornado_counts.csv")
print("   data/cyclone_counts.csv")

```
